text: Generated files may stay Overleaf regular files, never links; template change reaches Overleaf project’s next upload (Verify() skips ). Keep Makefile, project.Rproj, .gitignore files, scripts project’s build uses. Remove .setup/scripts/* except project.R. copy without Makefile: Rscript -e 'rProject::Template(getwd())' , make.

text: Files .setup/r-dependencies/ Overleaf links private functions repository (<lib>/<file> ), shared projects. Never edit project put upload folder. change one, edit local functions clone (next projects; agents never push) write upload folder functions; test, copy files scratch build project, project. Order: functions first; refresh links project push. reply log name links refresh. make linked compares files functions clone (FUNCTIONS=<path>).

title: wald
text: Overleaf’s GitHub sync stops 7 MB editable text caps text files 2 MB. Keep large data compressed (binary, e.g. .Rds .xz) never store file twice. make sizecheck reports problems.

title: wald
text: Every exported function roxygen documentation tests. make runs checks; fix every error, warning, note. Keep R style rules global instructions (BigCamelCase, one function per file, internal .Foo functions R/<pkg>-<name>-dot.R).

title: wald
text: package CRAN headed . R CMD check ---cran must pass errors, warnings, notes, R release R devel. Every user-visible change: version bump NEWS.md entry. Examples, tests, vignettes write tempdir(), use two cores, need internet unless skipped (skip_on_cran(), skip_if_offline()). Long examples go \donttest{}. submission: cran-comments.md (test environments, check results, reverse dependencies) reverse-dependency checks package . user submits CRAN. Agents prepare submission; never submit.

title: Wald Tests and Confidence Intervals — CIWald
text: Computes, parameter, Wald test statistic \(\left( \hat{\theta} - \theta_{0} \right) / \mathrm{se}\), two-sided \(p\) value, Wald confidence intervals, standard normal \(t\) distribution.

title: Wald Tests and Confidence Intervals — CIWald
code: CIWald(   est,   se,   theta = 0,   alpha = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),   z = FALSE,   df,   test = FALSE )

title: Wald Tests and Confidence Intervals — CIWald
text: est Numeric vector. Estimates. se Numeric vector. Standard errors estimates. theta Numeric vector. Parameter values null hypothesis true, length one length est. alpha Numeric vector. Significance level/s. z Logical. z = TRUE, use standard normal distribution. z = FALSE, use t distribution. df Numeric. Degrees freedom z = FALSE. test Logical. TRUE, return results hypothesis tests. FALSE, return results hypothesis tests confidence intervals.

title: Wald Tests and Confidence Intervals — CIWald
text: Returns numeric matrix one row per parameter following columns: est Estimates. se Standard errors. z t Test statistics. df Degrees freedom (z = FALSE ). p Two-sided p values. ci Confidence limits, one column per probability, named percentages, example 2.5% 97.5%. test = TRUE, confidence limits omitted.

title: Wald Test of a Parameter Vector — Wald
text: Computes Wald statistic $$   W =   \left( \hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}} - \boldsymbol{\theta}_{0} \right)^{\prime}   \operatorname{Var} \left( \hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}} \right)^{-1}   \left( \hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}} - \boldsymbol{\theta}_{0} \right) $$ \(p\) value \(\chi^{2}\) distribution degrees freedom equal number parameters. inverse computed Cholesky factor var_est.

title: Wald Test of a Parameter Vector — Wald

text: est Numeric vector. Vector parameter estimates (\(\hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}}\)). var_est Numeric matrix. Sampling covariance matrix parameter estimates (\(\operatorname{Var} \left( \hat{\boldsymbol{\theta}} \right)\)), symmetric positive definite. theta Numeric vector. Parameter values null hypothesis true (\(\boldsymbol{\theta}_{0}\)). NULL, vector zeros.
